definitions.decision_request: One request with scope, unique identity and exact payload digest, requiring an awaited response.
definitions.recycle_stop: Host stops before provider execution or native compaction; no implicit handover.
definitions.offline_host: Opt-in native host path limited to loopback providers and synthetic credentials.

product_prototype: Codex waits for ARE before each offline HTTP attempt and stops before native compaction.
business_prototype: Test control of context growth in the actual host without paid inference.

requirements: Full HTTP input with explicit output cap
No production login or provider access

acceptance: Threshold request causes zero provider calls
Compaction request causes zero compaction calls
Changed response binding, missing meter and server failure deny
Native host integration tests; an unavailable build is not_evaluable, never PASS
open_questions: Which live tokenizer and backend output contract can provide verified bounds?
How should a stopped host checkpoint tools and resume into a fresh context?
How will production proxy and TLS policy be preserved?
